description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class, which implements a fixed-size, circular buffer for double values, providing methods for adding, retrieving, and managing the buffer contents.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A fixed-size circular buffer for double values, implementing the DataBuffer interface.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the buffer, setting size and pointer to zero, effectively clearing stored data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a value to the buffer at the current pointer position, wrapping around if necessary.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements stored in the buffer.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns a copy of the stored values as an array.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value at the specified index in the buffer.
